# Common Pitfalls - Anti-Patrones

Los 7 errores más comunes que DEBES evitar.

## ❌ Los 7 Anti-Patrones

1. [**Over-Extracting Too Soon**](1-over-extracting-too-soon.md) - YAGNI violation
2. [**Client Component for Everything**](2-client-component-for-everything.md) - "use client" innecesario
3. [**Inline Complex Logic**](3-inline-complex-logic.md) - 50+ líneas en componente
4. [**Testing Everything**](4-testing-everything.md) - 100% coverage obsession
5. [**Not Using Server Components**](5-not-using-server-components.md) - Client-side fetch innecesario
6. [**Premature Optimization**](6-premature-optimization.md) - Memoization sin medir
7. [**Mixing Concerns**](7-mixing-concerns.md) - Fetch + transform + render together

## 🎯 Cómo Usar

- **Code Review:** Usa como checklist
- **Learning:** Lee cuando cometas el error
- **Prevention:** Revisa antes de commit
